name: tender-intelligence-platform
description: Production monorepo foundation for Tender Intelligence Platform

scripts.build: cross-env NODE_ENV=production dotenv -e .env -- turbo run build
scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development dotenv -e .env -- turbo run dev --parallel
scripts.test:security: cross-env NODE_ENV=test dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @tender/config exec vitest run test/environment.test.ts && cross-env NODE_ENV=test dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @tender/domain exec vitest run test/authorisation.test.ts test/rag-policy.test.ts test/drafting-policy.test.ts test/controlled-review-package.test.ts && cross-env NODE_ENV=test dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @tender/api exec vitest run test/security.test.ts test/documents.test.ts test/tenders.test.ts test/rag.test.ts test/drafts.test.ts test/final-readiness.test.ts test/controlled-review-packages.test.ts && cross-env NODE_ENV=test dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @tender/worker exec vitest run test/rag-security.test.ts test/ai-provider.test.ts test/malware-scanner.test.ts test/controlled-package-processor.test.ts
scripts.test:browser: cross-env NODE_ENV=test WEB_APP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3100 WEB_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:3100 WEB_PORT=3100 API_PORT=4200 API_PUBLIC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4200 NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4200 API_METRICS_PORT=4210 WORKER_HEALTH_PORT=4201 WORKER_METRICS_PORT=4211 dotenv -e .env -- playwright test
scripts.test: cross-env NODE_ENV=test dotenv -e .env -- turbo run test
